about.title: The Essence of Rest
about.subtitle: A haven designed to disconnect from the daily rhythm and reconnect with what matters, just steps from the sea.

location.title: Serene Location
location.description: On Avenida das Nações, the main avenue of Canasvieiras. Close to calm waters and the best local commercial spots.

breakfast.title: House Breakfast
breakfast.description: Artisanal buffet prepared every morning with fresh options and homemade pastries to start your day without rush.

warmth.title: Family Warmth
warmth.description: Close, human attention. Our team speaks your language and is available 24/7 to make you feel truly at home.

attractions.title: Discover Canasvieiras
attractions.subtitle: From our corner on Avenida das Nações, you have privileged access to the best experiences in Florianópolis.
attractions.whatsapp_query_template: Hello! I would like to know how to get to {{name}} from the Hotel.

brava.name: Praia Brava
brava.description: A natural haven a few minutes from our home, ideal for connecting with surfing and the island's serenity.

jurere.name: Jurerê Beach
jurere.description: Tradition and freshness at a short distance. An excellent option to share unforgettable moments near us.

aguashow.name: Água Show Park
aguashow.description: Guaranteed fun to enjoy with your loved ones. The most famous water park on the island is just steps from your stay.

centro.name: Historical Center
centro.description: A walk through the colonial architecture and the essence of Florianópolis. Discover the history surrounding our location.

frances.name: Frenchman Island
frances.description: Magical connection with marine wildlife and crystal clear waters. Tours and departures available very close to our reception.

fortaleza.name: São José Fortress
fortaleza.description: Panoramic views and a trip to the historical past. A meeting point with the local culture facing the ocean.

excursions.title: Hotel Excursions
excursions.subtitle: Discover the wonders of Florianópolis with direct transfers and coordination from our hotel, with no third-party agencies.
excursions.whatsapp_template: Hello! I would like to book the hotel's in-house excursion: *{{name}}*.

city_tour.name: City Tour Floripa
city_tour.description: A classic and charming tour around the island. Discover the main tourist sights: Hercílio Luz Bridge, Historical Center, Morro da Cruz Lookout, Lagoa da Conceição, Joaquina Beach, Barra da Lagoa, and Ingleses Beach.
city_tour.includes: Coordination, transfers, and official tour guide

beto_carrero.name: Beto Carrero World
beto_carrero.description: The largest theme park in Latin America. Spanning a 14 km² area full of adrenaline rides, live shows, and fun for the entire family.

ilha_campeche.name: Campeche Island
ilha_campeche.description: A true natural paradise with turquoise waters and crystal-clear sands. Declared a National Archaeological and Scenic Heritage site. Perfect for guided hiking and snorkeling.
ilha_campeche.includes: Boat crossing, navigation insurance, and guide

bombinhas.name: Bombinhas & Quatro Ilhas
bombinhas.description: Warm waters, white sands, and beautiful natural pools ideal for recreational diving and family relaxation on one of the most stunning shorelines in the south.

guarda_embau.name: Guarda do Embaú
guarda_embau.description: Chosen among the 10 most beautiful beaches in Brazil. Renowned for its mystical canoe crossing over the Madre River to reach the surfers' coast.
guarda_embau.includes: Transfer, traditional canoe crossing, and guided trekking

joaquina.name: Joaquina & Barra da Lagoa
joaquina.description: Two of the island's most iconic beaches. Includes a visit to the famous Joaquina dunes (where sandboarding is practiced) and the warm atmosphere of the Barra fishing village.

footer.tagline: Feel the warmth of a space designed for your well-being. Your refuge of authentic hospitality on the main Avenida das Nações.

hero.subtitle: Authentic hospitality on Avenida das Nações. A corner designed for your absolute rest, just steps from the sea.

home.map_subtitle: Strategically located on Avenida das Nações, the main avenue of the resort. Verify our proximity, just steps from the calm waters beach.

rooms.title: Our Rest Spaces
rooms.subtitle: Discover a corner where proximity to the sea and dedicated attention create the perfect setting for your days in Canasvieiras.

single.name: Single Room
single.description: Your personal haven of calm. A space designed for absolute rest after a sunny day on Avenida das Nações.

double.name: Double Room
double.description: The perfect setting to share. Privacy and comfort in a cozy environment just two blocks from the sea.

triple.name: Triple Room
triple.description: Space and warmth to enjoy together. The ideal layout for those looking for comfort and shared moments.

grupal.name: Family & Groups Plan
grupal.description: Dedicated attention for large groups. We coordinate every detail to make logistics simple and the experience unforgettable.

fallback_reviews.text: The location is perfect, steps from everything, with a warmth that made us feel right at home at all times.
Delicious breakfast and flawless service. It is the ideal place to disconnect with the family.
Excellent value for money. The service from the entire team was wonderful, we will be back soon.
